mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 10.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor market (PAYEMS) coupled with declining consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a mismatch where job growth is not translating to consumption, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and RSAFS falling does not produce negative returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with declining housing starts (HOUST) indicates a manufacturing sector expansion without corresponding housing demand, signaling economic imbalance and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO rising and HOUST falling does not produce negative returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a contraction in industrial output disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
